evidence.summary: The US Treasury names Joint Stock Company Scientific Research Institute Of Electrical Carbon Products among the Russia-based subsidiaries of Ruselectronics that OFAC designated in June 2022. It describes Ruselectronics as a holding company owned by Rostec, which it calls the cornerstone of Russia’s defence and industrial sectors, that unites Russia’s radio-electronic industry. OFAC lists it as linked to Ruselectronics, in Elektrougli.
It belongs to Ruselectronics, a holding company of the Russian state corporation Rostec.
